'disalui' on l7) or Pagolo?; l26: 'Giusto di salui' read from the image (Kraken saliiiº); the final 'ƒ i' makes ii + i + i = iiii, matching ƒ iiiiº on l17; l30: the lire figure looks like 'xlvi' rather than 'xvii'; not changed (numeral rule); l36: possibly ℔ xvi rather than ℔ xi; l38: the image looks like ℔ vi (francescho dandrea's line); not changed; l40: 'di ligo' may be 'di Rigo' (R looks like B/l in this hand); l43: after ℔ the figure may be 'viiiiº' rather than 'liiiiº'; l44: may be ƒ iii with the last stroke at the box edge; l47: last word could be 'partito' or 'partite'; l48: the image looks like ℔ vi ß iiii; not changed; l56: soldi figure may be 'ii' rather than 'iiii'; l58: no º visible; may be ß viii; l66: name looks like 'Nicolaio' (one c); l67: the final soldi figure has a Y-shaped stroke (= ii), as in Kraken
